semantics.output_size: Produced UTF-8 serialized tool content bytes, before agent-facing result-door delivery; may be overwritten by door originalBytes. Never delivered-byte savings.
semantics.output_ref: Non-null marks recorded actual result-door spill on the same invocation; nestedDispatch groups are excluded from agent-delivery totals.
semantics.percentiles: Per cohort only; do not average or merge group percentiles.
semantics.unknowns: NULL build/origin/size and missing client/tier metadata remain unknown. No rows means unmeasured traffic coverage, not zero bytes or zero spill rate.
semantics.callerClasses: excluded_nested_dispatch is an exclusion; explicit_full/projection/default_or_projection_unmeasured are distinct. Default label does not prove absence of implicit projection.

historicalReplay.extendedSql: WITH scoped AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT tool_name,serving_build_sha,call_origin,call_origin_source,transport,status,output_size,output_ref,args_json,metadata_json FROM harness_shared.tool_invocations WHERE workspace_id='papercusp-workspace' AND harness_slug='papercusp' AND invoked_at >= '2026-10-13T19:00:00Z'::timestamptz AND invoked_at < '2026-10-13T19:20:00Z'::timestamptz AND tool_name IN ('work_items:get','work_items:complete','improvements:capture','loop:checkpoint','work_items:create','scheduler:get_next','memory:list','dev:pipeline_position','accounts:status','plans:attention','plans:list','events:status','coord:orient','coord:inbox','plans:get','plans:evaluate-spec-test-adequacy','plans:get-spec-evidence','tools:find','dev:pg_query','testing:run-status','scorecards:list')), classified AS (SELECT *,CASE WHEN metadata_json ? 'nestedDispatch' THEN 'excluded_nested_dispatch' WHEN args_json->>'payloadTier'='full' THEN 'explicit_full' WHEN args_json ? 'projection' OR metadata_json#>>'{sourceMaterialization,promotedToFull}'='true' THEN 'projection' ELSE 'default_or_projection_unmeasured' END AS caller_class, metadata_json#>>'{requestOrigin,query,ctx_tier}' AS session_tier, metadata_json#>>'{requestOrigin,query,agent}' AS query_agent, metadata_json#>>'{requestOrigin,query,client}' AS query_client,metadata_json#>>'{requestOrigin,headers,x-papercusp-client}' AS header_client FROM scoped) SELECT tool_name,serving_build_sha,call_origin,call_origin_source,transport,status,caller_class,session_tier,query_agent,query_client,header_client,count(*) AS calls,count(output_size) AS sizes_measured,count(*) FILTER(WHERE output_size IS NULL) AS sizes_unknown,percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP(ORDER BY output_size) AS produced_p50_bytes,percentile_cont(0.9) WITHIN GROUP(ORDER BY output_size) AS produced_p90_bytes,count(*) FILTER(WHERE output_size>6000) AS produced_above6000,count(*) FILTER(WHERE output_ref IS NOT NULL) AS actual_spills,sum(output_size) AS produced_total_bytes FROM classified GROUP BY tool_name,serving_build_sha,call_origin,call_origin_source,transport,status,caller_class,session_tier,query_agent,query_client,header_client ORDER BY tool_name,serving_build_sha,call_origin,transport,status,caller_class,session_tier,query_agent,query_client,header_client
